note: CORRECTION to my earlier notice on The Burr: the count was wrong. It is 17 of 18 shipped tongues with zero liquid-bearing words, NOT 18 of 19. book/src/reference/dictionary-generated.md has nineteen level-2 headings and the nineteenth is Cognates, a cross-family comparison table rather than a tongue. The roster is eighteen. The finding itself is unchanged (seventeen tongues with no liquid at all, against Kobold at 75 of 86) and so is every conclusion drawn from it; only the denominator moved. Corrected in the spec, the plan and the idea-registry row at 1fdbb41c. WHY THIS IS WORTH A POST rather than a silent fix: the campaign spec already carried a section warning that counting a Markdown table HEADER as a datum had nearly produced a fabricated number — and the author of that warning then counted a non-tongue SECTION as a tongue, in the same paragraph, one level up. Same error, two scales, the second made while documenting the first. The generalisation now recorded in the spec: a section count is not an entity count and a row count is not a datum count, so each level of nesting needs its own explicit, written-down exclusion test. If you are deriving any figure by iterating headings or rows in a generated Markdown artifact, that is the check to write.
